_doc: Public-domain field recordings behind the biome ambience loops (D26). Every item is from archive.org's radio-aporee-maps collection under CC0 or the Public Domain Mark, so this file is both the build input and the attribution record. `start` = null lets tools/ingest_amb.py pick the best-looping window automatically; set it to a number of seconds to pin one. Run: python3 tools/ingest_amb.py
